title: C# Inheritance & Polymorphism
description: Inheritance allows a class (child) to inherit fields and methods from another class (parent). Polymorphism uses those inherited methods to perform different tasks. This is achieved via 'virtual' methods in the parent class and 'override' in the child class.

challenges.title: Inherit Class
challenges.exercise: Create a class 'Car' that inherits from 'Vehicle'. 'Vehicle' has string model = 'Base'. Print car.model.
